privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: What Mealio keeps about you, why, and how to take it back.

sections.heading: What we collect
bullets: Account details: your name, email address, optional phone number and a hashed password. We never store the password itself.
Mess records: meals, guests, bazaar costs, deposits and settings that you or your mess admin enter.
Telegram: your Telegram user ID, only if you link the bot.
Security records: sign-in attempts, the IP address they came from and similar events, so we can spot attacks on accounts.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your data to run the service: counting meals, working out the meal rate and balances, showing your mess what it needs to see, and helping you when you ask for support.
We do not sell your data and we do not show ads.

sections.heading: Who can see it
paragraphs: People in your mess see your name, meals, deposits and balance. Admins and managers also see your phone number and can manage your membership.
A small number of Mealio staff can access accounts to fix problems, handle support and stop abuse. Every staff action is logged.

sections.heading: Services we rely on
paragraphs: Your data is stored with our hosting and database providers. If email is turned on, we send emails such as password reset links through an email delivery provider. These providers only process data on our behalf.

sections.heading: Your choices
bullets: Download everything we hold about you from Settings, Privacy and data.
Delete your account from the same place. Your name and contact details are removed. Meal and money records stay in your mess's books under "Deleted member" so everyone else's totals stay correct.
Ask us anything through the support page.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If we change this policy in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app before it takes effect.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.lead: The short version: be fair, keep your records honest, and we will keep the lights on.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: Mealio helps a shared mess keep track of meals, bazaar costs, deposits and balances. It is a record-keeping tool. Mealio never holds or moves money for you.

sections.heading: Your account
bullets: Give a real name and an email address you can read.
Keep your password to yourself. You are responsible for what happens in your account.
One person, one account. Do not sign up on behalf of someone else without asking them.

sections.heading: Mess admins
paragraphs: Whoever creates a mess is its admin. Admins decide who joins, set the billing rules and can correct records. The numbers Mealio shows are only as accurate as the records the mess enters, so check them before settling money.

sections.heading: Fair use
bullets: No spam, fake messes or attempts to break into other people's accounts or messes.
No automated scraping or load that harms the service for others.
We may suspend a mess or account that breaks these rules. Contact support if you think we got it wrong.

sections.heading: Price
paragraphs: Mealio is free during early access, within fair limits on mess size. If we introduce paid plans later, we will announce them in advance and existing messes will not lose their records.

sections.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: We work hard to keep Mealio running and your data safe, but the service is provided as it is. We are not liable for disagreements between mess members or for losses that come from records being wrong or unavailable.

sections.heading: Leaving
paragraphs: You can export your data and delete your account at any time from Settings. Admins can delete their mess from Settings too.
